original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. One structure Adjudicator.Inv in ArmadaLean/Nitro/ holds the adjudicator safety facts as fields, with one theorem that every Step preserves it and one theorem that genesis satisfies it, so that every Reachable state satisfies it. Each existing safety Spec statement in ArmadaLean/Spec/Nitro/Safety.lean is proved from a field of it, and its statement does not change.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. At integrated 63b25c32, no declaration named Adjudicator.Inv exists. ArmadaLean/Nitro/Safety.lean proves the safety facts (for example held_falls_only_by_payout, redistribution_conserves_total, paid_out_monotone, finalized_permanent) as separate theorems, and Adjudicator.HeldInv covers only the coins-held fact.
How do you see it? Describe exactly how to observe this for yourself — the steps to reproduce, or how you would demo it. Run `git grep -n 'Adjudicator.Inv' ArmadaLean` and read ArmadaLean/Nitro/Safety.lean and Lemmas.lean.
What constraints apply? State them in plain prose. No spec statement changes: `git diff integrated -- 'ArmadaLean/Spec*'` is empty. scripts/check.sh --json keeps every _ok field true against scripts/gate-baseline.json; when a recorded finding is gone, scripts/update_gate_baseline.py rewrites the baseline in the same branch. A bare `lake clean` is never run.
Where does this apply? (e.g. gateway route, mobile screen, CLI verb) ArmadaLean/Nitro/Safety.lean, ArmadaLean/Nitro/Lemmas.lean
restatement: Create one Lean structure Adjudicator.Inv in ArmadaLean/Nitro/ that bundles the adjudicator safety facts (coins-held, held-falls-only-by-payout, redistribution-conserves-total, paid-out-monotone, finalized-permanent) as fields, prove one theorem that every Step preserves this structure and one theorem that the genesis state satisfies it, so that a derived theorem shows every Reachable state satisfies it. Each existing safety statement in ArmadaLean/Spec/Nitro/Safety.lean must then be proved by projecting a field out of Adjudicator.Inv, with no change to the wording of those Spec statements. The change must keep scripts/check.sh --json fields true against the baseline (updating the baseline file in-branch if a finding is fixed) and must never invoke a bare lake clean.

restatement_clauses.text: A structure named Adjudicator.Inv exists in ArmadaLean/Nitro/ with the adjudicator safety facts as its fields.
A theorem proves that every Step preserves Adjudicator.Inv.
A theorem proves that the genesis state satisfies Adjudicator.Inv.
A theorem (derived from the preservation and genesis theorems) proves every Reachable state satisfies Adjudicator.Inv.

Each existing safety Spec statement in ArmadaLean/Spec/Nitro/Safety.lean (held_falls_only_by_payout, redistribution_conserves_total, paid_out_monotone, finalized_permanent) is proved from a field of Adjudicator.Inv.
No Spec statement's wording changes: git diff integrated -- 'ArmadaLean/Spec*' is empty.

scripts/check.sh --json keeps every _ok field true against scripts/gate-baseline.json, with the baseline rewritten in the same branch via scripts/update_gate_baseline.py when a recorded finding is gone.
A bare lake clean is never run as part of the change.

goal: Combine several separately-proved safety facts about the adjudicator (money can't disappear except via payout, totals stay conserved, payouts only grow, finalized stays finalized) into one bundled invariant object, prove that invariant holds at the start and is preserved by every step so it holds for every reachable state, and re-derive the existing safety guarantees from that one bundle without changing what those guarantees say.
acceptance_criteria: Checks that the ArmadaLean/Nitro codebase defines a structure called Adjudicator.Inv that bundles the adjudicator safety facts as named fields.

Checks that the project contains a completed mathematical proof showing that every possible Step keeps the Adjudicator's invariant (Inv) true, and that this proof compiles cleanly with no gaps or placeholders.
Checks that the project's proof files actually contain and successfully compile a theorem showing the genesis (starting) state of the system satisfies the Adjudicator invariant.

Anyone can run a check that compiles the project's formal proof files and confirms there is a proven theorem stating that every reachable state satisfies the Adjudicator invariant, built from the preservation and genesis theorems.

Checks that the four safety guarantees listed in Safety.lean (held_falls_only_by_payout, redistribution_conserves_total, paid_out_monotone, finalized_permanent) are each fully proved, with no placeholder 'sorry' left in their proofs, and that each proof actually mentions a field of Adjudicator.Inv as its justification.

Checks that none of the wording in the ArmadaLean Spec files has been changed compared to the integrated baseline. A person could verify this by running a diff of the Spec files against the integrated branch and seeing no output at all.
After running the project's check script with the --json flag, every field whose name ends in _ok should read true, confirming no gate check is failing against the committed baseline.
Checks that the changes made for this task never run a plain, unqualified 'lake clean' command anywhere in the project's scripts, build files, or commit history for this change.
